business_scope.primary_industry_name: Recombinant Yeast Expression of Fast-Acting Human Insulin Analogs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-57 and R.561-1 to R.561-64; CMF Article L.561-2-2 and R.561-1 (UBO register); Décret n°2017-1094 du 12 juin 2017 relatif aux bénéficiaires effectifs des sociétés; Code de commerce Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. (RCS obligations); Code civil Articles 1832 to 1844-17 (SARL).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business License of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) of the People's Republic of China or equivalent competent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (HCCH Convention of 5 October 1961) for China-issued documents on or after 7 November 2023; otherwise French Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Current corporate register record of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or corporate service provider in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; if the issuing jurisdiction is not an Apostille party, French Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution authorizing the incorporation of the French SARL and execution of powers of attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign corporate shareholder, notarized by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of each ultimate beneficial owner's valid passport and proof of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority and competent notary public or consulate in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French Consular Legalization, plus sworn French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, manager, and controlling shareholder against the French national asset-freeze list (Ministère de l'Économie, Direction générale du Trésor), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UN Security Council consolidated list, and the OFAC SDN list whenever US-dollar clearing or US nexus is present. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons under CMF Articles L.561-10 and R.561-19. For this High_Risk_Special_License biopharma scope, negative news, adverse media, and beneficial-ownership-piercing checks are also mandatory before filing formation documents.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises operated by INPI (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); public searchable registers: data.inpi.fr and Infogreffe (RCS databases)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be lawful, distinctive, and not contrary to public order or good morals. The name may be chosen in any language but must be expressed in or transliterated into the Latin/Roman alphabet for RCS searchability. Filings with the registry and all mandatory legal notices are made in French; non-French documents require sworn French translation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Guichet Unique or registry rejects a requested name, the applicant receives a reasoned refusal. The applicant may either file a revised formation dossier with a distinguishing element or, within one month of refusal, lodge a petition before the President of the competent Tribunal de Commerce (or the competent administrative court where INPI issued the refusal) to challenge the decision. In the case of opposition based on prior trademark or trade-name rights, the applicant may appeal to INPI's Director within two months or initiate judicial proceedings before the civil courts.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual or domiciled offices are permitted in France for a SARL only for administrative and legal-seat purposes, provided the domiciliation provider is a licensed commercial domiciliataire d'entreprise and a domiciliation agreement is filed. For ISIC 2100 recombinant human insulin manufacturing, a virtual office is not sufficient as a substantive place of business; a physical, permanently staffed, GMP-qualified site is required before any manufacturing, importation, or distribution authorization is issued by ANSM or the EMA.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Very_High: estimated >85% probability of an unannounced or short-notice on-site inspection by ANSM/EMA within the first 24 months of operation, with additional inspections by labor and tax authorities once employees are declared.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), Book II, Title III, Chapters I-II: Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 (SARL incorporation, management and governance), including L. 223-2 (no statutory minimum capital), L. 223-7 (minimum one-fifth cash paid-up at subscription), L. 223-9 (publicity of the Statuts), and L. 123-1 et seq. (Registre du commerce et des sociétés - RCS). Procedural rules per Décret n° 84-406 and the single-window formalities under Ordonnance n° 2021-1389 and Décret n° 2021-1465.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the jurisdiction of the registered office (siège social), acting through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.inpi.fr; INSEE assigns SIREN/SIRET and DGFiP performs tax and VAT registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société (standardized M0 creation form), filed together with the executed Statuts and statutory annexures through the Guichet Unique portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for a French SARL (Art. L. 223-2); the capital is fixed in the Statuts, fully subscribed by the shareholders, and the cash contributions must be paid up to at least one-fifth (20%) at subscription (Art. L. 223-7), with any balance payable within five years. The paid-up funds must be consigned in a non-withdrawable escrow account with a French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, held until RCS registration is obtained, and then released to the Gérant.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the shareholders, having fully subscribed the share capital of the Company, unanimously adopt the French Articles of Association (Statuts) of this société à responsabilité limitée (SARL), whose corporate object is the manufacture of pharmaceutical products, including recombinant human insulin. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the registered office be fixed at the address stated in the Statuts, effective upon RCS registration. RESOLVED: that [Name] be appointed Gérant with full powers within the corporate object, and that [Pharmacist Name] be designated Pharmacien Responsable. RESOLVED: that the cash capital be consigned to an escrow account and that the Gérant be authorized to publish the legal announcement, lodge the dossier with the Guichet Unique (INPI), and complete the RCS, tax and regulatory license filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, execution and optional notarization of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate counsel (avocat) and/or Notaire (public notary) where notarial form is chosen; preparing documents for subsequent filing at the Guichet Unique (INPI).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language Statuts under Code de commerce L. 223-1 et seq., defining the corporate object as the manufacture of pharmaceutical products, notably recombinant human insulin (APE 2100Z); fix the registered office (siège social) in France; allocate subscribed share capital among shareholders; incorporate governance rules for the Gérant, shareholders' meetings and share-transfer restrictions; ensure the future pharmacien responsable holds a French-recognized pharmacy qualification for ANSM licensing. All shareholders and the appointed Gérant must sign the Statuts; notarize if real-property contributions are made or if preferred for evidentiary value; retain an English translation solely as an auxiliary document.
required_dossiers: Executed French Statuts (Articles of Association)
Identity documents and tax residency information of each shareholder
Written consent of the Gérant (déclaration de consentement) and of the designated Pharmacien Responsable
Declaration of beneficial owner (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
Proof of availability and legal entitlement to the registered office (lease or title deed)
Draft of the M0 creation form for verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the corporate object, governance or appointment clauses, amend and re-execute the Statuts by unanimous shareholder decision free of charge before the initial filing; on substantive defects, issue a supplementary explanatory annex.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Consignment of paid-up share capital and issuance of escrow deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution (bank) selected by the shareholders or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a non-withdrawable, blocked capital subscription account in the name of the future company; deposit at least one-fifth (20%) of the cash portion of the subscribed capital per Art. L. 223-7 Code de commerce; instruct the depositary to issue the official certificate of funds deposit (certificat du dépositaire des fonds) in accordance with Art. R. 223-4 and to hold the funds for release to the Gérant only upon presentation of the RCS registration (Kbis), in line with Art. L. 223-8.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening and AML/KYC documentation of the signatories
Capital deposit remittance order and transfer receipt
Escrow certificate of deposit (certificat de dépôt des fonds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed, obtain redelivery within 24 hours from the bank; if withheld on AML grounds, file a source-of-wealth declaration and seek resolution through the bank's internal complaints function or the financial ombudsman.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the incorporation legal notice in an authorized announcements gazette (Journal d'annonces légales - JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any legal announcements gazette approved by arrêté préfectoral for the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the mandatory French notice stating the legal form (SARL), corporate name, share capital, registered office address, corporate object, duration, and the identity of the Gérant; place the announcement through the approved JAL within the statutory deadline (generally one month before filing); obtain the publisher's attestation de parution for attachment to the incorporation dossier.
required_dossiers: Notice text drafted by counsel
Extract of the Statuts for verification by the gazette
Publication order and payment to the JAL
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is materially inaccurate, arrange a corrective republication before filing; if the gazette is not currently licensed for the department, select an authorized title and republish.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the incorporation application through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique (formalites.inpi.fr), the single statutory filing portal operated by INPI, which transmits the dossier to the Greffe, DGFiP, INSEE and social security bodies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to formalites.inpi.fr, select 'création d'entreprise', choose the commercial company (SARL) route, complete the standardized M0 declaration, upload the executed Statuts, the capital deposit certificate, the legal publication attestation, the beneficial-owner declaration, identity documents, proof of registered office, and the signed declaration on honor; pay the RCS emoluments and due taxes online; monitor the portal dashboard for the acknowledgment of receipt and any completeness or regularization requests.
required_dossiers: M0 creation form (déclaration de constitution)
Executed Statuts in French
Certificat du dépositaire des fonds (capital escrow certificate)
Attestation de parution from the authorized JAL
Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs
Identity documents of shareholders and Gérant
Justificatif de jouissance des locaux (proof of premises entitlement)
Déclaration sur l'honneur de non-condamnation incorporated in the filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of rejection or request for completion (mise en conformité), respond with corrected documents within the 15-day statutory window; if the portal filing fails, correct and resubmit; unresolved administrative refusals may be contested before the competent tribunal judiciaire.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration, issuance of the Kbis extract and allocation of tax and statistical identifiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the registered office jurisdiction; INSEE (SIREN/SIRET); DGFiP and DRI services (VAT and tax registration).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The greffier verifies the legality of the Statuts and the completeness of the dossier, orders the entry in the Registre du commerce et des sociétés, and issues the Kbis extract which is the definitive proof of incorporation; the same administrative transmission automatically allocates the SIREN/SIRET numbers, the APE code 2100Z, the French VAT number and any intercommunity VAT registration, and the company employer number; retrieve the Kbis before executing lease, banking, insurance or commercial supply agreements.
required_dossiers: Tracking number from the Guichet Unique (dossier provider number)
Acknowledgment of receipt from INPI
Copies of any substantive regularization replies submitted to the registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is refused (refus d'immatriculation), file a motion before the juge commis à la surveillance du registre; where the portal does not transmit, escalate by immediate rectification filing; subsequent amendments to registered particulars are filed separately as modification requests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM) - Direction des établissements pharmaceutiques et des inspections, with notification to the European Medicines Agency (EMA); supplementary permitting from the Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) for environmental authorization and from the local Inspection du travail for occupational compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'exploitation d'un établissement pharmaceutique de fabrication (manufacturing authorization for human-use medicinal products) issued under Articles L. 5124-2 and R. 5124-1 et seq. of the Code de la santé publique, following an ANSM GMP inspection of the recombinant human insulin drug-substance facility; recognized EU-wide under Article 40 of Directive 2001/83/EC.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique, acting through the Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) and the Préfet de département under the statutory single environmental authorization (autorisation environnementale).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Classified installation for environmental protection (ICPE) under rubrique 3340 of the nomenclature (use of genetically modified micro-organisms, here recombinant yeast, in industrial processes), subject to the authorization regime (régime de l'autorisation); a full environmental impact assessment (étude d'impact) is mandatory under Arts. L. 122-1, R. 122-2 and L. 512-1 Code de l'environnement and is integrated into the single authorization (Art. L. 181-1) together with the public inquiry and opinion of the environmental authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the general ministerial orders and the site-specific arrêté préfectoral d'autorisation: treated aqueous discharges into surface water must not exceed pH 5.5-8.5, total suspended solids 35 mg/L, BOD5 30 mg/L and COD 125 mg/L (monthly average, with peak limits per the order of 2 February 1998); fermentation effluents and biological waste must be fully inactivated (validated heat treatment at not less than 121°C for 30 minutes or equivalent) before release; containment and waste-handling must meet Directive 2009/41/EC (deliberate use of genetically modified micro-organisms, Class 2 conditions) and Code de l'environnement R. 532-6; Volatile organic compound emissions, odour control and solvent abatement must comply with the applicable ICPE orders and, where relevant, the IED thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety and civil defense clearance: fire and explosion risk assessment, fire-compartmentation certificate and, where applicable, a Plan d'Opération Interne (POI), verified by the Préfet with the Service départemental d'incendie et de secours (SDIS); building structural load and electrical safety verifications issued by an accredited technical inspection body (bureau de contrôle technique). Occupational clearance: registration of the facility with the Inspection du travail; biological-agent risk assessment under Code du travail Livre IV (R. 4421-1 et seq.); biosafety level 2 containment confirmation for the recombinant yeast process; medical surveillance through the occupational health service; certification of pressure equipment and ATEX zones; and compliance with workplace health and safety rules for pharmaceutical manufacturing staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr; business registration portal: Guichet des Entreprises (guichet-entreprises.fr)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign or newly established entities must first complete legal formation through the Guichet des Entreprises to obtain INSEE identifiers (SIREN/SIRET). The DGFiP then attributes the French VAT number (n° TVA intracommunautaire). Non-resident entities supplying taxable goods or services in France must file Form 1601-FR-SD with the competent tax office (service des impôts des entreprises) accompanied by certificates of incorporation, bylaws, proof of foreign tax residence, and any license evidencing the regulated biopharma activity. A physical establishment in France triggers mandatory SIREN registration and ongoing French VAT filing obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — SARL is subject to standard corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) at the territorial level; profits are taxed in France on a worldwide basis for French-established entities, subject to treaty relief for foreign-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: French law does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. A qualifying SARL de famille may elect income tax treatment (transparence fiscale) under Article 239 bis AA of the French Tax Code absent abusive use. Corporate tax status (IS) is mandatory for a standard commercial SARL, but certain partnerships and family vehicles may opt into IS. ATAD hybrid mismatch rules apply independently; election choices cannot override statutory mismatch adjustments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: France has no general turnover threshold for established taxable persons; a VAT franchise (franchise en base) applies to qualifying small businesses below €91,900 annual turnover for predominant sale of goods and €36,800 for services (2025 limits). Intra-EU distance sales of goods trigger registration at €10,000 EU-wide aggregate annual turnover. A non-resident supplier making any taxable supply in France must register for French VAT immediately without minimum turnover. An SARL manufacturing and selling insulin in France will be outside the small-business franchise because the activity is a licensed commercial pharmaceutical manufacture generating B2B receipts.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing and e-reporting are phased in under the 2023 Finance Act. From 1 September 2026 large enterprises must issue e-invoices via the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or a certified Private Dematerialisation Platform (PDP); all other taxable persons must comply from 1 September 2027. B2B invoices must comply with Factur-X or UBL formats. B2C transaction data must be transmitted to DGFiP as e-reporting. No per-transaction customs-style pre-clearance or physical digital stamp exists, but transmission is machine-read and monitored with real-time fiscal analytics and deadlines for data submission.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods outside the European Union are zero-rated (0% VAT) if the seller proves that the goods physically left France and the EU before the VAT return deadline. Intra-Community supplies to a taxable person in another EU member state are zero-rated when the seller holds the customer's valid EU VAT number, issues a compliant recapitulative statement (état récapitulatif, DEB), and proves transport of goods out of France. Services performed directly for non-EU customers or services linked to export activity may be outside the scope of French VAT under the place-of-supply rules. Recombinant human insulin manufactured under a pharmaceutical license qualifies for zero-rating when exported provided all documentary evidence is contemporaneous and complete.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Electronic Administrative Document, DAU) lodged with French Customs (EAS)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from France and the EU
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank FX transfer record evidencing cross-border payment receipt
For intra-EU zero-rating: customer's EU VAT number and the DEB/EU sales list recapitulative statement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: French tax and customs administrations may deny zero-rating where the export proof bundle is incomplete, inconsistent, retroactively altered, or where goods are returned into France without valid customs procedures. If zero-rating is challenged, the tax authority issues a VAT assessment at the 20% standard rate with late-payment interest (intérêts de retard). Bad-faith or fraudulent claims attract a 40% to 80% penalty for intentional understatement or concealment, and criminal penalties may apply. For misused export documents, the liability extends jointly to transporters and intermediaries. The statute of limitation for reassessment generally extends over six calendar years, and any repayment claim is clawed back in full plus legal sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully liberalized Euro-based currency regime with unrestricted capital account convertibility. Profit remittances face no statutory convertibility barriers; however, all cross-border flows are subject to mandatory AML/CFT screening, beneficial ownership disclosure, and corporate tax reporting obligations. High-risk biopharma entities require enhanced due diligence on source of funds and ultimate beneficial owners.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds applies under French law. Companies may retain foreign exchange earnings in foreign currency accounts. Repatriation must occur within statutory timelines (typically 30 days for certain transactions) and be declared for VAT and corporate income tax purposes. Banks process repatriation via SWIFT without conversion mandates.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited feasibility for offshore digital EMIs due to stringent AML requirements for high-risk biopharma entities. Platforms such as Wise or Revolut typically restrict services for licensed pharmaceutical manufacturers; local bank accounts remain the preferred and compliant solution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote KYC and account opening is permitted for French SARLs via video conferencing and qualified electronic signatures. Directors may be required to appear for in-person interviews in cases of high-risk profiling, complex ownership structures, or enhanced due diligence triggers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk source of funds from international investors, biotech R&D grants, or third-country entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide corporate manufacturing license, GMP certification, export contracts, beneficial ownership certificates, audited financial statements, and board resolutions to demonstrate legitimate business purpose and mitigate sanctions screening failures

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections use SWIFT MT103 with purpose codes 'CAP' or 'EQUITY'. Verification requires source-of-funds documentation, board resolutions, tax identification numbers, and beneficial ownership certificates. All transactions must be routed through licensed French banks to ensure regulatory compliance and audit trail integrity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed via SWIFT MT103 for direct payments or Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600. Sovereign Health LCs may be utilized for health-related transactions. Purpose codes must specify 'trade payment' or 'service fee' with supporting invoices and regulatory filings.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps for multi-currency liquidity management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (balance sheet, income statement, notes) and management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) filed electronically via the INPI Guichet Unique portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting to approve accounts within 6 months of fiscal year end; filing with registry within 1 month of approval (maximum 7 months from year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered financial penalty of up to EUR 1,600; after two consecutive years of non-filing, risk of administrative strike-off (radiation d'office) and loss of legal personality

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporation tax return (liasse fiscale, forms 2065-SD, 2050 series to 2059)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of fiscal year end; for calendar-year entities, on or before 3 May (electronic filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% tax increase plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; rate rises to 40% if filed after formal notice lapses

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final corporate income tax balance payment (solde de l'IS, form 2572-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 15th day of the 4th month following the fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 5% penalty plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20% if unpaid by close of the 30-day grace period

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of UBO declaration (bénéficiaire effectif)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) in conjunction with the annual accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Mandatory annual confirmation at each accounts filing; any shareholding change triggering UBO variation must be declared within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 37,500 for individuals and EUR 187,500 for legal entities; RCS may suspend filings and order strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual CFE business property contribution turnover declaration (form 1447-C-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed on or before 15 December of each year for the current tax base
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% increase on the under-declared base plus late interest; loss of small-business turnover-based exemptions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) if the SARL exceeds two of three thresholds: balance sheet total over EUR 4,000,000, net turnover over EUR 8,000,000, or average headcount over 50; also triggered by certain biopharma licensing conditions and by shareholder requests where required by law
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) for statutory individual annual accounts, regulated by the Autorité des Normes Comptables (ANC); IFRS permitted only for consolidated financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The beneficial owner register (RBE) entry is re-certified at each annual accounts filing; any share transfer in the SARL must be recorded in the ownership register and the UBO file amended at the Greffe within 30 days of the transfer; the annual filing serves as the presumptive confirmation of beneficial ownership unless a formal variation notice was lodged earlier
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members and share transfers (registre des associés et registre des mouvements de titres)
Minute book of shareholders' ordinary and extraordinary decisions (registre des procès-verbaux d'assemblées)
Personnel register (registre unique du personnel) where 50 or more employees are employed

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $5,500–$27,000 (EUR 5,000–25,000) per year for a mid-sized biopharma SARL

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (CGI Art. 219 I); reduced 15% rate applies to the first €42,000 of taxable profit of qualifying small enterprises (PME) with turnover ≤ €10M, as defined in CGI Art. 219 I-b
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Jeune Entreprise Innovante (JEI) status: 100% CIT exemption in the first year and 50% exemption in subsequent 4 years for qualifying R&D-intensive SMEs (CGI Art. 44 sexies-0 A); Recherche Credit Impôt (CIR): 30% credit on eligible R&D expenditure up to €100M per annum and 5% above, with a 1-year carryforward for the refundable portion (CGI Art. 244 quater-B); reduced tax credit for
